name: ci
description: Run a configured CI check for a repository. Use action 'list' to see available checks, then 'run' with a check name to execute one. Only checks explicitly configured in $SHAI_HOME/ci.json can be run. Pass 'cwd' to target a checkout other than the current working directory, and 'tool_dir' to have a specific tools directory's ci/run.sh orchestrate the run (e.g. a checkout's tools/ when dogfooding a change to the ci tool itself). Every list/run output begins with a 'ci-tool: <resolved path>' line naming the run.sh that orchestrated it, so it is visible whether the installed tool or a checkout's tool ran. The check runs in an environment scrubbed of every exported SHAI_* variable and the API keys (PATH/HOME/LANG/TERM survive), so the repository under test never observes the agent's own run/span/session state; a per-check "env" map in ci.json re-injects a variable for the rare check that needs one. The scrub covers SHAI_* names and DEEPSEEK_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY only; any other credential the agent exports (e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN) still reaches the check.

files.hint: copy ci.json.example to it (default ~/.shai/ci.json), then edit the repos map

action.description: Action to perform: 'list' shows available checks for the repo, 'run' executes a specific check.

check.description: Name of the check to run (required when action is 'run'). Must match a key in the repo's checks config.

cwd.description: Optional directory to detect the repository in and run the check from, e.g. a clone under /tmp. Defaults to the current working directory.

tool_dir.description: Optional tools directory whose ci/run.sh should orchestrate this invocation, e.g. a checkout's tools/ dir when verifying a change to the ci tool itself. The resolved run.sh is exec'd with the same input minus tool_dir, so the checkout's tool — not the installed one — drives the run. Only honored when explicitly given; never derived from repo content.
